messages:
deploy-bot: deploy started for model 'redwood/lite-v2@sha:abc123' -> pool:us-west-1a. Canary set: 10 instances. Trigger: tag 'release/2026-03-17'.

maria: saw odd canary outputs ~10:23 UTC — some responses have replacement chars and truncated JSON. Routing looks normal but a few requests return malformed tokens.

tim: seeing tokenizer mismatch vs baseline for simple prompts. Example: 'Summarize the quarterly earnings' returns truncated JSON and weird tokens. Could be tokenizer config or wrong weights.

ajay (oncall): I'm oncall and got paged. PD-9876 created. @maria can you paste a repro/sample? If this affects customers bump to P1.

maria: sample payload/response: ```POST /v1/generate
input: "Summarize the quarterly earnings"
response: "{\"summary\":"Quarter� results show..."}"
log: KV error: unknown-vocab-id 0x14
```

ops-bot: Canary error rate: 12% (baseline 0.2%). Latency +30ms.

leah: digging into registry now — artifact alias 'latest' may have been advanced before weights/tokenizer verification. Checking artifact hashes.

tim: also seeing orphaned KV cache misses on the old shard map; lots of cache-miss churn which could amplify errors.

ajay (oncall): Action items: enable live kill-switch for pool-us-west-1a, rollback canary traffic, and disable model alias 'model-v202'. @leah start rollback. @maria enumerate top affected customers.

deploy-bot: kill switch enabled for pool-us-west-1a. Initiating rollback: target model -> redwood/lite-v2@sha:abc122.

leah: rollback kicked off. Pipeline shows alias 'latest' temporarily pointed to abc123 — re-pointing to abc122 and validating checksums.

tim: flushing KV caches on the affected pool to avoid stale embeddings: `redis-cluster flush --namespace model-kv-usw1a` (running now).

maria: impacted customers/tickets so far: support#4521 (enterprise), support#4523 (enterprise), 3 sandbox dev orgs reported garbled responses. No escalations beyond these yet.

ajay (oncall): PD severity -> downgraded to P2 while rollback proceeds. Continue monitoring for 15m post-rollback.

ops-bot: rollback progress: 8/10 canary instances rolled back. Error rate falling to 1.5%.

leah: root cause reconnaissance: release pipeline allowed alias promotion before tokenizer metadata verification step — alias update + artifact promotion happened out of order. Adding preflight check for tokenizer hash vs weightset.

tim: will run canary suite again and a cache invalidation sweep; prepping a small patch to the deploy pipeline.

maria: drafting customer note: 'We briefly served an incorrect model artifact in us-west-1a causing garbled output for a subset of requests. We rolled back the canary and mitigations are in place. If you observed corrupted responses, please reply with request id or example.'

ajay (oncall): handing off to SRE rotation for follow-up. @leah @tim you'll lead the incident write-up and remediation items. Handoff timestamp 5977773540.

sre-rotation: acknowledged. We'll take postmortem, add pipeline guard (verify tokenizer metadata/hash), lower canary alert thresholds, and add an explicit check to block alias promotion until verification passes.
summary: Canary rollout served wrong artifact (alias advanced prematurely) causing tokenizer/weight mismatch in us-west-1a; kill-switch enabled and canary rolled back; caches cleared; follow-up postmortem and pipeline guard planned.
